why_agent_cannot: the drop requires a Telegram or Discord account session
what_human_must_do: Don't send more SOL or USDC to the agent's wallet.
Watch @familiarsfamily on X for news about the site and agent wallets. Its last post was on 29 September 2026.
costs: The service itself was advertised as free: "Free to run: familiars pays for the AI." What you paid was the money you funded the agent with, all of it at risk, plus network fees and the price impact of its trades. The project said on 29 September 2026 that users would soon be able to buy AI credits themselves, and that was its last post on X. No fee schedule was published.
risks: The website returned an error on every page on 18 October 2026, and the project hadn't said why. Most agents lost. In the site's own data on 8 October 2026, 599 agents had traded, and 501 of them were down overall. There are no terms of service, privacy policy, age limit or country rules.
